screen.abyssalport.locked.8: Explore the Darklands or collect Abyssalnite to reveal this page.
screen.abyssalport.abyssalnite: Small Abyssalnite veins form in stone below the Darklands at Y 4–31. Mine them with an iron pickaxe or better, then smelt the ore. Nine nuggets make an ingot; nine ingots make a storage block. Both conversions reverse without loss.
screen.abyssalport.abyssalnite_note: Craft tools with ingots and wooden rods, or a full armor set. Ingots repair the equipment in an anvil. The equipped helmet grants water breathing; boots grant Speed I.
message.abyssalport.necronomicon_status: Potential energy: %s / %s PE — research pages are not ported yet
message.abyssalport.collector_status: Collector: %s / %s PE. Use a Necronomicon to transfer energy.
message.abyssalport.energy_status: %s: %s / %s PE. Use a Necronomicon to transfer energy.
message.abyssalport.pedestal_empty: Place one offering on the pedestal.
message.abyssalport.ritual_hint: Hold a Necronomicon with 100 PE. Place four books on any four pedestals; leave the others empty.
message.abyssalport.ritual_requirements: Ritual unavailable: check all eight pedestals, four books, your Necronomicon and its PE.
message.abyssalport.formation.created: The cobblestone ritual ground has formed.
message.abyssalport.formation.not_cobble: Use the Necronomicon on the central cobblestone block.
message.abyssalport.formation.incomplete: Place cobblestone at all eight ritual positions around the center.
message.abyssalport.formation.obstructed: Clear the space around every outer cobblestone block.
message.abyssalport.formation.crosses_ch: The entire ritual ground must fit within one chunk.
message.abyssalport.formation.unloaded: The ritual ground is not fully loaded.
message.abyssalport.formation.protected: You cannot form a ritual ground here.
screen.abyssalport.locked.3: Form a ritual ground to reveal the Basic Scroll instructions.
screen.abyssalport.locked.4: Find a Shadow Fragment to reveal the shadow material notes.
screen.abyssalport.locked.5: Let a monolith effigy charge your Necronomicon to reveal Energy Collectors.
screen.abyssalport.locked.6: Study an Energy Collector with your Necronomicon to reveal the PE network.
screen.abyssalport.locked.7: Enter the Darklands to record this environment.
screen.abyssalport.intro: The Necronomicon records hidden energy and ritual knowledge. These pages currently describe the first working steps of this unfinished study.
screen.abyssalport.energy: New monoliths carry seven possible deity statues on Monolith Stone above a living biomass core. Mine and relocate the statue. Under open sky, its base rate is 5 PE per 120 active ticks. Eight gold ingots around a diamond craft a blank Ritual Charm. In an anvil, combine ONE blank charm with an arrow (range), gunpowder (power) or redstone (duration), costing one level. Use the modifier on an inactive statue; a blank charm clears it without being consumed. Inspect with an empty hand. Generic modifiers give 10 PE, or 15 for Power; Duration halves the interval and Range adds four blocks. Mining the statue removes its modifier. Dropped-book/collector timing and range pillars are implemented; the three validated structures are implemented; full disruptions remain unfinished.
screen.abyssalport.energy_note: Craft four Monolith Stone in a square into one Monolith Pillar. Up to two consecutive pillars directly below a statue each add four blocks of book range and one collector search layer. Full stone does not count. Held books use a 120-active-tick timer with 0-9 ticks of restart jitter; dropped books and collectors each have an independent 1-in-120 chance per tick. Generic Duration changes these to 60 active ticks and 1-in-80. No player is needed for dropped books or collectors. Tolerance is saved per accepted transfer; complete disruptions are still development. The three Places of Power are explained at the end of this book.
screen.abyssalport.ground: Place nine cobblestone blocks as shown. Keep the whole ground within one chunk and the space around each pedestal clear. Use this book on the center block.
screen.abyssalport.scroll: Place four ordinary books on any four ritual pedestals. Leave the other four empty. Hold a Necronomicon with at least 100 PE and use it on the altar.
screen.abyssalport.scroll_note: Stay nearby and keep the offerings in place until the ritual finishes. Energy and books are spent only on success.
screen.abyssalport.shadow_materials: Shadow Creatures drop 1–3 Shadow Fragments. Four fragments make a Shard; four Shards make a Gem. Both conversions can be reversed at a crafting table.
screen.abyssalport.shadow_materials_note: Seek Shadowed Soil in rare Darklands pockets. Small patches in dark forests and swamps remain as a fallback. Shadow Creatures spawn on this soil at night.
screen.abyssalport.collector: Place an isolated Energy Collector three blocks horizontally from an open-sky statue or older effigy. It stores up to 1,000 PE. Craft one with eight Darkstone and a Shadow Gem. Do not place another collector directly against its sides, top or bottom.
screen.abyssalport.collector_note: Use a Necronomicon on the collector to take up to 100 PE. Sneak-use to return up to 100 PE. The stored energy remains in the block when mined.
screen.abyssalport.network: Craft a Collector from eight Monolith Stones around a Shadow Gem; a Relay uses six Monolith Stones, one Shadow Gem and two Shadow Shards along one edge. A Relay draws from any PE device directly behind it and sends to the FIRST device ahead. Placement follows the clicked face; empty-hand use cycles six directions. Full blocks obstruct its beam; partial shapes do not. Redstone pauses it. A full first receiver is not skipped.
screen.abyssalport.network_note: Base: 4-block reach, 10 PE per 20 ticks in, 20 per 40 ticks out, 10,000 reservoir capacity. Open the reservoir: left drains, right charges books or device items at 20 PE/tick. Craft an Embossed Ring with four gold ingots and four blaze powder. Infuse it on a base ritual ground with a 400-PE book; rings upgrade ONE device in an anvil for one level. Names and stored PE remain intact.
screen.abyssalport.darklands: Rare Darklands pockets carry Shadowed Soil. Shadow Creatures can spawn on this soil at night.
screen.abyssalport.darklands_note: Mine Darkstone veins at Y 0–64, then smelt the cobblestone for early PE devices. Lesser Shoggoths can build monoliths at clear sites.
message.abyssalport.altar_occupied: The altar is occupied or a ritual is running. Use an empty hand to retrieve the ingredient.
screen.abyssalport.locked.9: Find Coralium beneath an ocean or swamp.
screen.abyssalport.locked.10: Find Coralium to reveal the first infusion ritual.
screen.abyssalport.coralium: Mine Coralium Ore below oceans and swamps with an iron pickaxe. It drops 1–3 gems. Fortune increases the yield; Silk Touch preserves the ore. Combine 2–9 gems into a cluster or unpack a cluster without loss.
screen.abyssalport.coralium_note: Surround a nine-gem cluster with eight stone blocks, then smelt the infused stone into one Coralium Pearl. Alternatively, place three three-gem clusters between two rows of stone.
screen.abyssalport.infusion: Put one Coralium Pearl on the central altar. Fill the eight pedestals with 2 diamonds, 2 ender pearls and 4 blaze powder, in any order. Activate with a Necronomicon holding at least 300 PE. The resulting Transmutation Gem remains on the altar.
screen.abyssalport.infusion_note: Use an empty hand to collect the result. A Transmutation Gem surrounded by four Shadow Gems crafts an Oblivion Shard. The catalyst survives ten crafts, losing one use each time. Breaking the altar returns its stored ingredient.
message.abyssalport.sacrifice_missing: No eligible adult creature is within four blocks of the altar.
message.abyssalport.sacrifice_selected: Sacrifice selected: %s. Slay the glowing creature near the altar before the ritual ends.
message.abyssalport.sacrifice_interrupte: Sacrifice ritual interrupted. PE and altar ingredients were not consumed.
screen.abyssalport.locked.11: Create a Transmutation Gem to study the Oblivion ritual.
screen.abyssalport.sacrifice: Place an Eye of Ender on the altar and put 4 redstone dust and 4 Oblivion Shards on the pedestals. Keep a fully charged 5,000-PE Necronomicon in hand. An adult animal, bat, water creature, spider or villager must be within four blocks of the altar; children and undead are excluded.
screen.abyssalport.sacrifice_note: Starting the ten-second ritual marks the selected creature with a glow. Slay that creature near the altar before time runs out. Stay within eight blocks and keep the book in hand. On completion, retrieve the Oblivion Catalyst with an empty hand. Despawn, escape and unloaded creatures never count as a sacrifice; cancellation preserves PE and ingredients, but cannot undo a creature's death.
message.abyssalport.gateway_created: Gateway formed. Your key has been returned.
tooltip.abyssalport.gateway_key: Right-click air to select a destination. Place on the altar for the 1,000-PE portal ritual.
screen.abyssalport.locked.12: First create an Oblivion Catalyst to learn about gateways.
screen.abyssalport.locked.13: Visit the Abyssal Wasteland to reveal these notes.
screen.abyssalport.gateway: Craft a Gateway Key with two Coralium Pearls, two Blaze Rods and an Oblivion Catalyst. Right-click air until its destination is Abyssal Wasteland. Put the key on a formed ritual altar. Place one Shadow Gem on each cardinal pedestal (north, east, south, west); leave the four diagonals empty. Activate with a Necronomicon holding at least 1,000 PE.
screen.abyssalport.gateway_note: Keep two blocks above the altar clear and remain nearby for two seconds. The altar becomes a gateway anchor, all eight pedestals become pillars, and your selected key is returned. Step into the portal: a linked return gateway is created at a safe destination. Keep both anchors intact. An unknown dimension or obstructed ritual cancels without consuming ingredients or PE.
screen.abyssalport.wasteland: An eternally dark wasteland of Abyssal Stone, fused sand and Coralium lakes. The toxic liquid causes Coralium Plague: avoid direct contact, and use solid paths or a bucket with care. Milk does not cure this disease. This world does not support beds or respawn anchors; do not try to sleep here.
screen.abyssalport.wasteland_note: Bring food, spare blocks, tools and your key. Record your return gateway coordinates before exploring. Entering that linked portal returns you to its original anchor, including after a world reload. If its landing becomes blocked, travel searches for another safe site without clearing buildings. Take the key back to the Overworld to form another gateway when needed.
screen.abyssalport.locked.14: Enter the Abyssal Wasteland or obtain Refined Coralium to reveal this chapter.
screen.abyssalport.wasteland_mining: Wasteland ores replace Abyssal Stone. Iron tools mine Abyssal Iron, Gold, Diamond and Nitre; Abyssal Coralium needs diamond or better and drops gems. Bring an Abyssalnite Pickaxe to mine Liquified Coralium at Y 5-34. Smelt this ore into Refined Coralium: one ingot per ore, or use a blast furnace. Craft tools and armor with ingots and the usual equipment patterns.
screen.abyssalport.refined_coralium_note: Refined Coralium tools have 1,800 uses and can mine Pearlescent Coralium at Y 5-19 for 1-2 Coralium Pearls (Fortune increases drops; Silk Touch preserves ore). Abyssalnite and vanilla tools cannot harvest pearlescent ore. Refined helmets grant Water Breathing, chestplates Resistance and boots Speed only while equipped. These effects do not make Coralium Plague harmless. Ingots repair the equipment in an anvil; nine ingots or nuggets reversibly form a block or ingot.
screen.abyssalport.wasteland_creatures: Abyssal Zombies inhabit this dimension and spread Coralium Plague through successful melee attacks. They breathe underwater, resist the plague, attack ordinary zombies and can infect defeated zombies or villagers. Their flesh is unsafe food: it causes hunger, nausea and plague. Rare Coralium Chunks from player kills smelt into two Refined Coralium Ingots; mining Liquified Coralium is the reliable route.
tooltip.abyssalport.rending_staff: Right-click a visible creature to collect rending energy.
screen.abyssalport.locked.15: Discover an Oblivion Shard or a Staff of Rending first.
screen.abyssalport.locked.16: Enter the Abyssal Wasteland to learn the next book upgrade.
screen.abyssalport.rending: Craft the Staff of Rending from four Shadow Shards and an Oblivion Shard. Right-click while aiming at a visible creature, at most 50 blocks away. Each successful drain deals one damage and collects one energy. Walls, invulnerable targets and repeated clicks during the half-second cooldown give no energy.
screen.abyssalport.rending_note: Drain Abyssal Zombies in the Abyssal Wasteland: 100 Abyssal energy yields one Wasteland Essence. Shadow Creatures yield Shadow energy in any dimension; 200 creates a Shadow Gem. Full energy is exchanged on right-click; if the inventory and item drop both refuse the reward, the energy stays in the staff.
screen.abyssalport.wasteland_book: Surround one Wasteland Essence with eight Coralium-Plagued Flesh to craft one Skin of the Abyssal Wasteland. In a 2 x 2 pattern, place three skins and your Necronomicon in the bottom-right corner. The upgraded book stores 10,000 PE; the old book is consumed, not returned.
screen.abyssalport.wasteland_book_note: The upgrade retains stored PE, custom names and other book data. Effigies, collectors, relays and the Energy Container recognize both tiers and obey each book's actual capacity. Your discoveries remain attached to you, not copied from another player's book.
message.abyssalport.formation.book_too_w: This ritual ground needs a stronger Necronomicon.
message.abyssalport.formation.wrong_dime: Form this ritual ground in the Abyssal Wasteland.
screen.abyssalport.wasteland_rituals: In the Abyssal Wasteland, use your upgraded book on the same nine-block ritual pattern made from Abyssal Cobblestone. Put your Staff of Rending on the central altar; place one Shadow Gem, four Abyssal Stone and three Coralium-Plagued Flesh on the eight pedestals in any order. Start with a tier-one book holding at least 1,000 PE. The upgraded staff deals and collects two per successful drain, retaining its stored energy, name and other data. Excess energy survives redemption.
message.abyssalport.summon_blocked: The creature could not appear. Clear the space above the altar and check the difficulty. Your PE and offerings were retained.
screen.abyssalport.locked.17: Craft the Wasteland Necronomicon to study Asorah's summoning.
screen.abyssalport.asorah: Prepare an Abyssal ritual ground in the Abyssal Wasteland. Leave the central altar empty; place four Gold Ingots, one Transmutation Gem, one Liquid Coralium Bucket and one Enchanting Table on seven pedestals in any order. Leave the eighth empty. Use a tier-one Necronomicon with 1,000 PE. Asorah appears above the altar after one second; a blocked or refused spawn consumes nothing. Peaceful difficulty cannot summon him.
screen.abyssalport.asorah_fight: Asorah has 400 health and alternates airborne sweeps with lower approaches. Aim for the head: body, tail and wing hits are reduced. Nearby Spectral Dragons heal him by giving up their own health, so remove them first. He rejects potion effects and ordinary mob damage. After defeat, his ten-second death sequence releases one Eye of the Abyss, Coralium materials and experience. The Eye records your discovery when collected. Drops obey doMobLoot.
message.abyssalport.tracker_dimension: The tracker only answers in the Abyssal Wasteland.
message.abyssalport.tracker_missing: No unclaimed Wasteland Stronghold could be found.
tooltip.abyssalport.powerstone_tracker: Throw in the Wasteland to seek an unclaimed Stronghold. May shatter.
screen.abyssalport.stronghold: Eight Coralium Gems around an Eye of Ender craft four Powerstone Trackers. Throw one in the Wasteland: it flies towards an underground Stronghold, then returns with an 80% chance. Repeat throws do not claim the structure. Dig carefully when it descends; Coralium trenches and Abyssal Zombie spawners guard the chambers.
screen.abyssalport.stronghold_note: In the central ritual chamber, a Dreadlands Infused Powerstone stands on a dry pedestal. A Refined Coralium Pickaxe (tier five) is required to collect it; weaker tools lose the drop. Collecting it marks that Stronghold as explored, so trackers seek another. The Powerstone and Asorah's Eye are the ingredients for the next Gateway Key.
screen.abyssalport.locked.19: Collect the Stronghold Powerstone to reveal the next key infusion.
screen.abyssalport.locked.20: Enter the Dreadlands to reveal these notes.
screen.abyssalport.dreadlands_key: In the Abyssal Wasteland, form a tier-one ritual ground from nine Abyssal Cobblestone blocks. Put your basic Gateway Key on the altar. Place one Transmutation Gem, the Stronghold Powerstone and Asorah's Eye on any three pedestals; leave five empty. Use a tier-one Necronomicon with 10,000 PE and remain nearby for ten seconds. The infused key stays on the altar.
screen.abyssalport.dreadlands_key_note: Right-click air to select a destination; sneak to cycle backwards. This key retains the Overworld/Wasteland link and opens Wasteland/Dreadlands travel. It cannot jump directly from the Overworld to the Dreadlands. Use the existing 1,000-PE cardinal Shadow Gem portal ritual with the infused key on a basic ritual ground. A linked return anchor is created on arrival. Keep both anchors intact.
screen.abyssalport.dreadlands: Dark red Dreadstone terrain contains Dreaded Abyssalnite, Dreadlands Abyssalnite and blue Elysian Stone deposits. A tier-four Abyssalnite or tier-five Refined Coralium Pickaxe can collect this stone; ordinary Netherite cannot. Dreaded Abyssalnite smelts to an Abyssalnite Ingot. Dreadlands Abyssalnite requires later processing.
screen.abyssalport.dreadlands_note: Fireproof, undead Dreadlings have 30 health and six melee damage. Successful hits inflict five seconds of Dread Plague: one magic damage per 25 ticks and hunger exhaustion. Milk cannot cure it. Dreadlings resist their own plague and may drop zero to two Dread Fragments, increased by Looting. This entry-stage dimension does not yet contain its full forest/ocean ecology, mineshafts or late bosses.
screen.abyssalport.locked.21: Reach the Dreadlands to learn this book upgrade.
screen.abyssalport.dreadlands_book: Drain Dreadlings with a Staff of Rending in the Dreadlands. 100 Dread energy creates one Dreadlands Essence; creatures outside this dimension give no Dread energy. Surround an essence with eight Dread Fragments to craft one Skin of the Dreadlands. Three skins and the Wasteland Necronomicon in a 2 x 2 pattern upgrade the book to 20,000 PE.
screen.abyssalport.dreadlands_book_note: The book upgrade preserves PE, name and other components. The eight fragments must come from actual Dreadling drops. Use the same nine-block ritual pattern, now made of Dreadstone Cobblestone in the Dreadlands, and form it with a tier-two book. A weaker book, a mixed pattern or the wrong dimension changes nothing.
screen.abyssalport.dreadlands_rituals: Upgrade the Wasteland Staff on the central altar: one Shadow Gem, four Dreadstone and three Dread Fragments on the pedestals in any order; 2,000 PE in a tier-two book. The new staff drains three per successful hit and keeps all stored channels and its name. A second ritual infuses one Coralium-Infused Stone with eight Dreadlands Essences for 5,000 PE to create another Powerstone. This later alternative cannot replace the first Wasteland Stronghold visit.
screen.abyssalport.transmutator: Mine Coralium Stone from the Abyssal Plateau to obtain cobblestone. Smelt the cobblestone into stone, then smelt stone into bricks. Craft the machine from five Coralium Bricks, a Transmutation Gem, two Refined Coralium Blocks and a Coralium Bucket. Crafting returns the empty bucket and spends one catalyst use. Each operation takes ten seconds. Stone, cobblestone and stone bricks can be converted to their Darkstone counterparts and back. A Coralium Brick converts into Coralium Stone.
screen.abyssalport.transmutator_fuel: This is not a coal furnace. Coralium Gems and Bricks fuel one operation; a Pearl fuels ten. Coralium clusters, plagued flesh and Blaze Powder or Rods also work. A Coralium Bucket lasts 1,000 seconds and leaves one empty bucket. Burning a Transmutation Gem consumes the entire gem; its ten reusable charges apply only to crafting. The machine will not start burning fresh fuel if no recipe matches or the output is blocked.
screen.abyssalport.transmutator_automati: Feed ingredients from above and fuel from the sides. Extract finished items and empty buckets from below. The progress, remaining fuel and inventory survive world reloads. Changing the input recipe or blocking the output resets processing progress; already burning fuel still runs down. Shift-click moves materials between your inventory and the machine. Breaking the machine returns its stored items.
screen.abyssalport.dreadguard: Dreadguards are rare, three-block-tall armoured elites in the Dreadlands. They have 60 health, heavy armour and a plague-inflicting melee attack. After their cooldown they stop moving for a three-second spray: stay clear of their face, use solid cover, and do not rely on armour against its magic damage. Dread carriers resist this plague. Ordinary melee damage can still hurt another carrier.
screen.abyssalport.dreadium: Defeating Dreadguards can drop Dreaded Shards of Abyssalnite. Process each shard in the Transmutator for one Dreadium Ingot; this is not a furnace recipe or an ore shortcut. Each ingot stores 0.2 experience in the machine. Nine ingots form one storage block; ingots and nuggets also convert nine-to-one and back. Four Dreadstone make four Dreadstone Bricks. These reachable materials prepare the next machinery tier. Dreadium tools have 2,300 uses and mine level-six materials. Its four armour pieces use the usual ingot patterns and repair with Dreadium ingots. The chestplate grants brief Resistance and boots brief Speed only while equipped; the helmet does not add water breathing, and the set does not make you immune to plague.
screen.abyssalport.crystallizer: Build the Crystallizer from six Dreadstone Bricks, two Dreadium Blocks and a furnace. An operation takes ten seconds and may produce two different materials. Both outputs need enough space: if either is blocked, no fresh fuel is burned and the input remains intact. Stone separates into silica and magnesia shards; water provides hydrogen and oxygen. Only plain water bottles work, not other potions. Empty buckets and bottles remain in the input slot.
screen.abyssalport.crystallizer_fraction: Nine fragments make a shard; nine shards make a crystal; nine crystals make a cluster block. Every step is reversible without loss. Nitre separates into potassium and nitrate, lapis into silica and sulfur, and Dreaded Abyssalnite Ore produces both Abyssalnite and Dreadium crystals. Crystal chemistry is available for silica, magnesia and nitrate. These processing recipes are separate from furnace recipes.
screen.abyssalport.crystallizer_fuel: Coal is an ingredient, not direct fuel. Use Dread Fragments, Dreaded Shards, Blaze Powder or Rods, or processed Carbon Crystals and cluster blocks. A Carbon Crystal powers one operation, a cluster nine. Feed ingredients from above and fuel from a side. Extract outputs and returned buckets/bottles from below. World reloads preserve inventory, fuel and progress; changing the recipe resets progress. Taking either output pays saved experience once.
screen.abyssalport.crystal_processing: Eight Carbon Crystals around an empty center form a Carbon Cluster. Eight clusters around Obsidian form a Dense Carbon Cluster: transmute it into one diamond. Their Crystallizer fuel values are eight and 64 operations. A Sulfur Crystal Cluster transmutes into one Sulfur dust. Combine seven Nitre dust, Sulfur and Charcoal in the recorded shaped recipe for four gunpowder. Recovery in the Transmutator is intentionally lossy: nine-crystal metal clusters return only one ingot, and a single metal crystal returns one nugget. Crystal fraction crafting itself remains lossless.
message.abyssalport.crystal_bag.invalid: This bag contains invalid or oversized data. Nothing was removed.
screen.abyssalport.crystal_bags: Two String, six Leather and one Gold Ingot make a Small Crystal Bag with 18 slots. Right-click it in either hand to open it. Store crystal fragments, shards, crystals and crystal cluster blocks. Shift-click moves crystals between the bag and your inventory. Other items and nested bags are not accepted. The held bag stays locked while its inventory is open; switching away closes access. Each bag keeps its own contents through saves, drops and travel.
screen.abyssalport.crystal_bags.upgrade: Surround the small bag with eight Skins of the Abyssal Wasteland for 36 slots. Surround that medium bag with eight Skins of the Dreadlands for 54 slots. Both upgrades preserve crystal contents, occupied positions and custom names, while consuming the old bag exactly once. The original's 72-slot Omothol tier is not available until its genuine late-game ingredients are implemented; it is not replaced by a cheap placeholder recipe.
screen.abyssalport.darklands.wood: Darklands Oak grows a 9–11-block trunk, thick roots and wide ascending branches. Both normal and hollow logs make four planks, or one Charcoal in a furnace (200 ticks, 1 XP). Use planks for the native early wood recipes and the complete door, stairs, slab, fence, gate, button and pressure-plate family. Leaves can drop saplings (Fortune improves the chance); shears or Silk Touch preserve the leaves, not apples. Replant on dirt or Darklands Soil. Bone Meal advances a sapling before attempting growth. Allow room for six-block branches: a blocked tree refuses to grow rather than destroying your building.
screen.abyssalport.dreadlands.ecology: Dread Spawn climb and inflict five seconds of plague after an accepted melee hit. Five nearby small Spawns can become one Greater Spawn; five nearby Greater Spawns one Lesser Dreadbeast. The replacement must actually enter the world before exactly five participants disappear. Larger forms use six-damage plague slugs at range, and smaller offspring may emerge periodically or after their real deaths. Small Spawns drop Dread Fragments; larger forms drop Dreaded Shards for the native Dreadium route. Local population limits bound natural spawning and periodic offspring. The original's hardcore overrides and bespoke audio are not yet present.
screen.abyssalport.darklands.variants: Darklands Plains and Highlands have sparse Oaks; the Forest has dense Oaks. Highlands have Darkstone under their soil; Mountains expose Darkstone on top and contain no trees. All variants retain the early ore and monolith paths and unlock the same Darklands discovery. The older Darklands biome key is retained for saves. Native climate and erosion place these variants in compatible terrain; old 1.12 height fields are not copied. The remaining creature ecology and larger structures are separate development.
screen.abyssalport.darklands.ruins: Small Darklands houses, shrines, memorials and unused ritual grounds occur naturally. Use the basic book on the centre of a complete nine-block Darkstone Cobblestone ring to form its tier-zero altar; do not mix the two cobblestone materials. The ring must remain within one chunk. Shrines contain the currently available PE effigy. Glowing Darkstone Bricks emit full light and require a diamond-tier pickaxe. Graveyards are connected. Shoggoth lairs and the named deity/Idol of Fading systems are still separate development.
screen.abyssalport.ghouls.guide: Graveyards occur naturally in the Overworld and Darklands. At night, active tombstones can raise one Ghoul every 200 ticks, capped at five nearby Ghouls within 15 blocks; daylight, Peaceful and disabled mob spawning pause them. Breaking a tombstone removes the source permanently: even Silk Touch does not return it. Stone raises ordinary Ghouls; Darkstone raises poison-immune Shadow Ghouls. Their flesh has harmful food effects. Crystallizing either produces twelve phosphorus shards; Shadow flesh also gives one Shadow Shard. Buried graves may contain ordinary remains, not boss progression loot. Omothol and Dark Realm variants remain separate development. Depths Ghouls breathe underwater and have rare named/baby variants; accepted hits spread Coralium Plague only in the Wasteland with the current default rules. Dreaded Ghouls resist fire and spread Dread Plague. Abyssal/Coralium tombstones raise Depths; Dreadstone/Elysian raise Dreaded. Dimensional graves contain the matching ordinary remains and one or two skins; Spirit Tablet rare treasure remains unfinished. Crystallizing their flesh gives twelve phosphorus shards and one matching Coralium/Dreadium shard. Shoggoth remains give eight phosphorus shards, with two matching fragments for dimensional remains. Rare Depths heads can be placed or worn.
screen.abyssalport.shoggoth_lairs: Look for descending stone lairs in swamps and rivers, the Abyssal Wasteland and Dreadlands. Their biomass attempts a spawn every 400 active ticks when a non-spectator player is within 16 blocks. Six living Shoggoths of any form within 32 blocks stop further spawns. After five successful admissions a node becomes ordinary Monolith Stone. Peaceful and disabled mob spawning pause the timer. Breaking biomass removes it permanently, even with Silk Touch. Matching remains crystallize into eight phosphorus shards; dimensional remains add two corresponding crystal fragments. Groups can build monoliths at clear surface sites; the seven statues are reachable through newly built monoliths; full charm/disruption rules remain development.
screen.abyssalport.shoggoth_growth: Shoggoths hunt players, animals, ambient/water creatures, spiders, ordinary zombies and skeletons; only the registered animal/ambient/water/spider prey feeds them. A killed creature gives one food point per quarter block of body area, rounded up. Eight points turn a Lesser into a normal Shoggoth, while normal/Greater parents produce a Lesser/normal offspring. Growth waits for actual collision-safe admission, keeping food if blocked or cancelled. All forms climb, breathe underwater and resist poison, cactus and projectiles. Dimensional lairs can rarely supply Greater forms. Abyssal/Dreaded accepted hits apply the matching plague and their native remains feed dimensional crystallization. Head/body surfaces share native health. Larger forms spit acid every 120 ticks at distant targets; newborns can ride a spit. Acid wears ordinary armor and shields, but block corrosion obeys mob griefing and protects biomass, ooze, monolith stone and block entities. The later two worlds and full statue-amplifier/disruption rules remain development.
death.attack.shoggoth_acid.player: %1$s dissolved in Shoggoth acid while fighting %2$s
tooltip.abyssalport.charm_reset: Clears a statue or Energy Depositioner modifier; reusable.
tooltip.abyssalport.charm_use: Use on an unmodified statue or Energy Depositioner. Consumes one charm.
screen.abyssalport.power.guide: Build every shown block, then right-click the activation stone (*) with any Necronomicon. The book and its PE are not consumed. Any of the seven deity statues may be used, including mixed deities. Valid structures allow charging indoors and beside their other statues, and add no new tolerance. Break a required block and these benefits stop immediately; replace it to repair. Mining the activation block returns Monolith Stone, not a portable formed structure.
screen.abyssalport.power.materials.basic: 15 Monolith Stone + 4 Monolith Pillars + 4 statues. Activate the top center stone. Range +8 blocks; collector search radius +2 and depth +2. The lower 3x3 layer is solid stone; the middle layer uses pillars only in its four corners.
screen.abyssalport.power.materials.totem: 1 Monolith Stone + 3 statues stacked directly above it. Activate the bottom stone. Range +12 blocks; collector search radius +3 and depth +3. Statues must be real deity statues, not prototype effigies.
screen.abyssalport.power.materials.archw: 1 Monolith Stone + 1 statue + 6 walls + 4 stairs + 6 slabs. Any wall/stair/slab material works. Activate the floor center stone. Range +4 blocks; collector radius and depth +1. Both supports, all roof blocks, stair directions and upper/lower halves must match. Rotate the entire plan together for a north-south arch.
screen.abyssalport.power.diagram: Top view per layer; north is up, east is right. * = activation stone. E/W = stair facing east/west; T/B = upper/lower half. Empty cells are not required air blocks. All layers share the same center.

screen.abyssalport.shadow_family.guide: Darklands host three Shadow forms: Creatures drop 1–3 Fragments; Monsters can drop 0–2 Shards; Beasts can drop 0–2 Gems. All breathe underwater and resist fire, poison and attacks from their own Shadow family. Beasts gather breath after 300 active ticks, then exhale for 100 ticks. Close-range Shadow breath bypasses armour and adds blindness and slowness; walls stop it. Deaths caused by Shadows can transform non-Shadow creatures; player deaths leave a named persistent Monster while normal player respawn and inventory rules remain intact. A transformation refused by native protection creates no replacement. All three forms and Shadow Ghouls supply the Staff of Rending's Shadow channel.
screen.abyssalport.animal_ecology.guide: Evil cows, chickens, pigs and sheep hunt players. By default they appear only at night during a new moon. Shearing an Evil animal yields 1–3 leather, feathers, pork or wool and admits its matching Demon form; rejected transformations spend neither tool durability nor drops. Evil sheep that killed a player wear that player's skin and yield rotten flesh instead. Accepted Evil deaths normally leave a Demon; Shoggoth kills do not. Demons drop 0–2 rotten flesh and resist Dread Plague. They spawn in the Nether; Overworld burning is disabled by default. Enabled Demon trails respect mobGriefing and native block protection; water/rain extinguish them. Mimic Fire spreads less than normal fire, but still burns flammable blocks. Shub offspring appear above sea level on eligible nights in forests, more often in dark forests; they have 40 health and no item loot. Common ecology options are in abyssalport-common.toml; biome weights apply when the world loads.
screen.abyssalport.disruptions.guide: Unprotected statue charging accumulates tolerance: accepted book transfers add 2 (4 with a charm), collectors 1 (2 with a charm). At 100 the statue consumes its tolerance and selects one of the 18 common disruptions plus its deity's entries. Warning lightning is visual only; the selected effect can ignite, freeze, infect, teleport, drain PE or attract actual creatures. Shub's entries include animal corruption and offspring; equipped/ridden/leashed mounts are retained rather than losing gear. J'zahar and Yog-Sothoth can turn sacrifices into Depths Ghouls. Hastur and Nyarlathotep can summon invisible Endermen. Complete validated Places of Power prevent disruptions; saved labels alone do not protect you. The common config can disable disruptions. A single action-bar warning names the selected effect, without a permanent chat wall.
tooltip.abyssalport.energy_upgrade: Anvil: one lower-tier device + this ring; one XP level.
tooltip.abyssalport.pe_ring.0: Infuse with a 400-PE Necronomicon on base ritual ground.
tooltip.abyssalport.pe_ring.1: Infusion: 2 Shadow Shards, 2 Coralium Gems, 4 Cobblestone.
tooltip.abyssalport.pe_ring.2: Tier-one book; 2 each: Shadow Shard, Coralium Gem, Abyssal and Coralium Cobblestone.
tooltip.abyssalport.pe_ring.3: Tier-two book; 2 each: Shadow Shard, Coralium Gem, Dreadstone and Elysian Cobblestone.
screen.abyssalport.energy_pedestal: Energy Pedestal: seven Monolith Stones, a Coralium Pearl and a Shadow Gem. Place one book or PE device on top; the pedestal charges it from its stored PE at 20 PE/tick. Empty-hand use retrieves the actual item; a full inventory keeps it on the pedestal. It receives statue PE like a Collector; adjacent collectors or energy pedestals block that charging. Relays can supply it or draw PE from it. Capacities: 5,000 / 7,500 / 10,000 / 12,500 PE.
screen.abyssalport.energy_container_ritu: Reservoir infusion: place one Energy Pedestal on a base altar, offer four Energy Collectors and four Shadow Shards, and use a book with 100 PE. The pedestal's stored PE transfers to the reservoir, but not unrelated item tags. Empty its displayed item before mining it; breaking returns that item separately. The old prototype chest craft is no longer active.
message.abyssalport.sacrificial_altar_st: Sacrificial Altar: %s / %s PE · Cooldown: %s s · Targets: %s / %s
screen.abyssalport.sacrificial_altar: Sacrificial Altar: five Monolith Stones, two Shadow Fragments, one Coralium Pearl and one Shadow Gem. Tracks adult living mobs within 8 blocks horizontally and 3 vertically; undead and Shadow creatures are excluded. A tracked, accepted death yields its maximum health as PE, never a removed living creature or cancelled death. Place a book on top to charge it at 20 PE/tick. After collecting one fifth of capacity, cooldown begins: base 60 s, Overworld 50 s, Wasteland 40 s, Dreadlands 30 s. Capacities: 5,000 / 7,500 / 10,000 / 12,500 PE; targets: 1 / 2 / 3 / 4. Ring upgrades preserve PE and cooldown. No placed altar accepts external PE; its Relay output works. The base altar item cannot be charged, higher-tier items can. Breaking returns the displayed item separately.
tooltip.abyssalport.stone_tablet.blank: Seal items using a State Transformer
tooltip.abyssalport.stone_tablet.invalid: Invalid sealed data — contents left untouched
screen.abyssalport.state_transformer.gui: State Transformer: seven Monolith Stones, a wooden chest and one use of a Transmutation Gem. Stone Tablet: four Shadow Shards, four Monolith Stones and one Shadow Gem. In Pack mode, a blank tablet seals up to 49 cargo slots in 10 seconds; Unpack requires every cargo slot to be empty and returns the original items to their exact positions. Names, damage and components are retained. Nested bags, shulker boxes, bundles and other inventories are not cargo. Slots and mode are locked during processing. Automation: Pack accepts cargo from above and a blank tablet from the sides, returning the sealed tablet below. Unpack accepts a sealed tablet above and returns cargo and blank tablet below. The tablet's potential value is count × (64 / maximum stack size) per cargo stack, not rechargeable PE. Cursed tablets cannot be processed. A filled tablet can instead fuel the Energy Depositioner described below; that consumes its cargo permanently.
tooltip.abyssalport.energy_depositioner: Consumes sealed cargo; can spread Darklands
screen.abyssalport.energy_depositioner.g: Energy Depositioner: five Monolith Stones, two Shadow Gems, one Energy Relay and one use of a Transmutation Gem. WARNING: a filled, non-cursed Stone Tablet is fuel: its sealed cargo is permanently consumed, not returned. Processing takes 10 seconds and generates its cargo value as PE into a 10,000 PE buffer. The empty tablet returns at the right; a full output prevents starting or continuing another job. Place isolated collectors at least three blocks away to receive PE. Power, Range and Duration charms modify the original transfer factors; Blank Charm clears the modifier. Overflow at full capacity is lost. Unprotected transfers can cause disruptions. In the Overworld, processing also attempts to spread Darklands in a 17-by-17 footprint, changing ordinary stone/oak building blocks; existing machines are never replaced. Modern whole 4-by-4 biome cells entirely inside this footprint are used across the actual world height. Unloaded chunks are skipped; protection hooks can veto a cell. More Darklands increases the chance of a cursed output tablet. Use away from builds you want to preserve. Hoppers: filled tablet above, empty output below. Mining retains PE, both slots, modifier and the exact unfinished job in one non-stackable machine item.
